xgboost.description: XGBoost classifier on ViT-base-patch16-224 CLS embeddings

svm.description: SVM (RBF, C=10) with StandardScaler on ViT embeddings

dataset_provenance: Brain Tumor MRI Dataset — typically sourced from Kaggle (sartajbhuvaji/brain-tumor-classification-mri). Verify licence and terms before use. Training/Testing split is dataset-provided (not randomly split here).
limitations: Models trained on a single dataset; generalisation to other MRI scanners / populations is unknown.
Outputs are AI-assisted classification only and require review by a qualified clinician.
ViT embeddings are frozen during XGBoost/SVM training — a jointly fine-tuned pipeline may outperform.
No data augmentation applied during embedding extraction.
Class imbalance, if present in the dataset, is not corrected.
clinical_safety_notice: All predictions are labelled 'AI-assisted classification — Predicted class'. Outputs are NOT a diagnosis. Clinician review is mandatory before any clinical action.
